stem: Shaan places the fraction $\dfrac{2}{5}$ on a number line marked from $0$ to $1$.

options.text: Divide the interval from $0$ to $1$ into $5$ equal lengths and count $2$ of those lengths from $0$.
Mark a point near $1$ because the printed $5$ looks large.
The number-line placement rule also requires changing $\dfrac{2}{5}$ into a decimal first.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Partition the unit interval into 5 equal parts and take 2 of them from 0 to locate 2/5.

teacher.key_rationale: Equal partitioning of the unit interval and counting places the fraction. Printed digit size is a surface grab. Decimal conversion is outside this hinge.
